This\nincludes — but is not limited to:\u003c/p\u003e\n\u003cul dir=\"auto\"\u003e\n\u003cli\u003e\u003ccode\u003esystemctl {suspend,hibernate,hybrid-sleep,suspend-then-hibernate,poweroff,halt,reboot,kexec}\u003c/code\u003e\u003c/li\u003e\n\u003cli\u003e\u003ccode\u003eloginctl {suspend,hibernate,hybrid-sleep,suspend-then-hibernate,poweroff,halt,reboot}\u003c/code\u003e\u003c/li\u003e\n\u003cli\u003e\u003ccode\u003epm-{suspend,hibernate,suspend-hybrid}\u003c/code\u003e\u003c/li\u003e\n\u003cli\u003e\u003ccode\u003eshutdown {-h,-r,-P,-H,now,--halt,--poweroff,--reboot}\u003c/code\u003e\u003c/li\u003e\n\u003cli\u003eDBus calls to \u003ccode\u003eorg.freedesktop.login1.Manager.{Suspend,Hibernate,HybridSleep,SuspendThenHibernate,PowerOff,Reboot}\u003c/code\u003e\u003c/li\u003e\n\u003cli\u003eDBus calls to \u003ccode\u003eorg.freedesktop.UPower.{Suspend,Hibernate,HybridSleep}\u003c/code\u003e\u003c/li\u003e\n\u003cli\u003e\u003ccode\u003egsettings set ... sleep-inactive-{ac,battery}-type\u003c/code\u003e to any value other than \u003ccode\u003e'nothing'\u003c/code\u003e or \u003ccode\u003e'blank'\u003c/code\u003e\u003c/li\u003e\n\u003c/ul\u003e\n\u003cp dir=\"auto\"\u003e\u003cstrong\u003eWhy:\u003c/strong\u003e The host runs mission-critical parallel CLI-agent and\ncontainer workloads. On 2026-04-26 18:23:43 the host was auto-\nsuspended by the GDM greeter's idle policy mid-session, killing\nHelixAgent and 41 dependent services. Recurring memory-pressure\nSIGKILLs of \u003ccode\u003euser@1000.service\u003c/code\u003e (perceived as \"logged out\") have the\nsame outcome. Auto-suspend, hibernate, and any power-state transition\nare unsafe for this host.\u003c/p\u003e\n\u003cp dir=\"auto\"\u003e\u003cstrong\u003eDefence in depth (mandatory artifacts in every project):\u003c/strong\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\n\u003col dir=\"auto\"\u003e\n\u003cli\u003e\u003ccode\u003escripts/host-power-management/install-host-suspend-guard.sh\u003c/code\u003e —\nprivileged installer, manual prereq, run once per host with sudo.\nMasks \u003ccode\u003esleep.target\u003c/code\u003e, \u003ccode\u003esuspend.target\u003c/code\u003e, \u003ccode\u003ehibernate.target\u003c/code\u003e,\n\u003ccode\u003ehybrid-sleep.target\u003c/code\u003e; writes \u003ccode\u003eAllowSuspend=no\u003c/code\u003e drop-in; sets\nlogind \u003ccode\u003eIdleAction=ignore\u003c/code\u003e and \u003ccode\u003eHandleLidSwitch=ignore\u003c/code\u003e.\u003c/li\u003e\n\u003cli\u003e\u003ccode\u003escripts/host-power-management/user_session_no_suspend_bootstrap.sh\u003c/code\u003e —\nper-user, no-sudo defensive layer. Idempotent. Exits non-zero on any forbidden invocation.\u003c/li\u003e\n\u003cli\u003e\u003ccode\u003echallenges/scripts/host_no_auto_suspend_challenge.sh\u003c/code\u003e — asserts\nthe running host's state matches layer-1 masking.\u003c/li\u003e\n\u003cli\u003e\u003ccode\u003echallenges/scripts/no_suspend_calls_challenge.sh\u003c/code\u003e — wraps the\nscanner as a challenge that runs in CI / \u003ccode\u003erun_all_challenges.sh\u003c/code\u003e.\u003c/li\u003e\n\u003c/ol\u003e\n\u003cp dir=\"auto\"\u003e\u003cstrong\u003eEnforcement:\u003c/strong\u003e Every project's CI / \u003ccode\u003erun_all_challenges.sh\u003c/code\u003e\nequivalent MUST run both challenges (host state + source tree). Applies to every project,","submodule, container entry point, build script, test, challenge, and","systemd unit shipped from this repository.","","**Rule:** No code in this repository may invoke a host-level power-","state transition (suspend, hibernate, hybrid-sleep, suspend-then-","hibernate, poweroff, halt, reboot, kexec) on the host machine. This","includes — but is not limited to:","","- `systemctl {suspend,hibernate,hybrid-sleep,suspend-then-hibernate,poweroff,halt,reboot,kexec}`","- `loginctl {suspend,hibernate,hybrid-sleep,suspend-then-hibernate,poweroff,halt,reboot}`","- `pm-{suspend,hibernate,suspend-hybrid}`","- `shutdown {-h,-r,-P,-H,now,--halt,--poweroff,--reboot}`","- DBus calls to `org.freedesktop.login1.Manager.{Suspend,Hibernate,HybridSleep,SuspendThenHibernate,PowerOff,Reboot}`","- DBus calls to `org.freedesktop.UPower.{Suspend,Hibernate,HybridSleep}`","- `gsettings set ... sleep-inactive-{ac,battery}-type` to any value other than `'nothing'` or `'blank'`","","**Why:** The host runs mission-critical parallel CLI-agent and","container workloads. On 2026-04-26 18:23:43 the host was auto-","suspended by the GDM greeter's idle policy mid-session, killing","HelixAgent and 41 dependent services. Recurring memory-pressure","SIGKILLs of `user@1000.service` (perceived as \"logged out\") have the","same outcome. Auto-suspend, hibernate, and any power-state transition","are unsafe for this host.","","**Defence in depth (mandatory artifacts in every project):**","1. `scripts/host-power-management/install-host-suspend-guard.sh` —","   privileged installer, manual prereq, run once per host with sudo.","   Masks `sleep.target`, `suspend.target`, `hibernate.target`,","   `hybrid-sleep.target`; writes `AllowSuspend=no` drop-in; sets","   logind `IdleAction=ignore` and `HandleLidSwitch=ignore`.","2. `scripts/host-power-management/user_session_no_suspend_bootstrap.sh` —","   per-user, no-sudo defensive layer. Idempotent. Safe to source from","   `start.sh` / `setup.sh` / `bootstrap.sh`.","3. `scripts/host-power-management/check-no-suspend-calls.sh` —","   static scanner. Exits non-zero on any forbidden invocation.","4. `challenges/scripts/host_no_auto_suspend_challenge.sh` — asserts","   the running host's state matches layer-1 masking.","5. `challenges/scripts/no_suspend_calls_challenge.sh` — wraps the","   scanner as a challenge that runs in CI / `run_all_challenges.sh`.","","**Enforcement:** Every project's CI / `run_all_challenges.sh`","equivalent MUST run both challenges (host state + source tree). A","violation in either channel blocks merge. <div class="markdown-heading" dir="auto"><h2 tabindex="-1" class="heading-element" dir="auto">Numbered Rules</h2><a id="user-content-numbered-rules" class="anchor" aria-label="Permalink: Numbered Rules" href="#numbered-rules"><svg class="octicon octicon-link" viewBox="0 0 16 16" version="1.1" width="16" height="16" aria-hidden="true"><path d="m7.775 3.275 1.25-1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1 4.95 4.95l-2.5 2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1-4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1 .018-1.042.751.751 0 0 1 1.042-.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l2.5-2.5a2.002 2.002 0 0 0-2.83-2.83l-1.25 1.25a.751.751 0 0 1-1.042-.018.751.751 0 0 1-.018-1.042Zm-4.69 9.64a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l1.25-1.25a.751.751 0 0 1 1.042.018.751.751 0 0 1 .018 1.042l-1.25 1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1-4.95-4.95l2.5-2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1 4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1-.018 1.042.751.751 0 0 1-1.042.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0-2.83 0l-2.5 2.5a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 0 2.83Z"></path></svg></a></div>


<div class="markdown-heading" dir="auto"><h3 tabindex="-1" class="heading-element" dir="auto">CONST-033 — Host Power Management is Forbidden</h3><a id="user-content-const-033--host-power-management-is-forbidden" class="anchor" aria-label="Permalink: CONST-033 — Host Power Management is Forbidden" href="#const-033--host-power-management-is-forbidden"><svg class="octicon octicon-link" viewBox="0 0 16 16" version="1.1" width="16" height="16" aria-hidden="true"><path d="m7.775 3.275 1.25-1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1 4.95 4.95l-2.5 2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1-4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1 .018-1.042.751.751 0 0 1 1.042-.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l2.5-2.5a2.002 2.002 0 0 0-2.83-2.83l-1.25 1.25a.751.751 0 0 1-1.042-.018.751.751 0 0 1-.018-1.042Zm-4.69 9.64a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l1.25-1.25a.751.751 0 0 1 1.042.018.751.751 0 0 1 .018 1.042l-1.25 1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1-4.95-4.95l2.5-2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1 4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1-.018 1.042.751.751 0 0 1-1.042.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0-2.83 0l-2.5 2.5a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 0 2.83Z"></path></svg></a></div>
<p dir="auto"><strong>Status:</strong> Mandatory. Non-negotiable. Applies to every project,
submodule, container entry point, build script, test, challenge, and
systemd unit shipped from this repository.</p>
<p dir="auto"><strong>Rule:</strong> No code in this repository may invoke a host-level power-
state transition (suspend, hibernate, hybrid-sleep, suspend-then-
hibernate, poweroff, halt, reboot, kexec) on the host machine. This
includes — but is not limited to:</p>
<ul dir="auto">
<li><code>systemctl {suspend,hibernate,hybrid-sleep,suspend-then-hibernate,poweroff,halt,reboot,kexec}</code></li>
<li><code>loginctl {suspend,hibernate,hybrid-sleep,suspend-then-hibernate,poweroff,halt,reboot}</code></li>
<li><code>pm-{suspend,hibernate,suspend-hybrid}</code></li>
<li><code>shutdown {-h,-r,-P,-H,now,--halt,--poweroff,--reboot}</code></li>
<li>DBus calls to <code>org.freedesktop.login1.Manager.{Suspend,Hibernate,HybridSleep,SuspendThenHibernate,PowerOff,Reboot}</code></li>
<li>DBus calls to <code>org.freedesktop.UPower.{Suspend,Hibernate,HybridSleep}</code></li>
<li><code>gsettings set ... sleep-inactive-{ac,battery}-type</code> to any value other than <code>'nothing'</code> or <code>'blank'</code></li>
</ul>
<p dir="auto"><strong>Why:</strong> The host runs mission-critical parallel CLI-agent and
container workloads. On 2026-04-26 18:23:43 the host was auto-
suspended by the GDM greeter's idle policy mid-session, killing
HelixAgent and 41 dependent services. Recurring memory-pressure
SIGKILLs of <code>user@1000.service</code> (perceived as "logged out") have the
same outcome. Auto-suspend, hibernate, and any power-state transition
are unsafe for this host.</p>
<p dir="auto"><strong>Defence in depth (mandatory artifacts in every project):</strong></p>
<ol dir="auto">
<li><code>scripts/host-power-management/install-host-suspend-guard.sh</code> —
privileged installer, manual prereq, run once per host with sudo.
Masks <code>sleep.target</code>, <code>suspend.target</code>, <code>hibernate.target</code>,
<code>hybrid-sleep.target</code>; writes <code>AllowSuspend=no</code> drop-in; sets
logind <code>IdleAction=ignore</code> and <code>HandleLidSwitch=ignore</code>.</li>
<li><code>scripts/host-power-management/user_session_no_suspend_bootstrap.sh</code> —
per-user, no-sudo defensive layer. Idempotent. Safe to source from
<code>start.sh</code> / <code>setup.sh</code> / <code>bootstrap.sh</code>.</li>
<li><code>scripts/host-power-management/check-no-suspend-calls.sh</code> —
static scanner. Exits non-zero on any forbidden invocation.</li>
<li><code>challenges/scripts/host_no_auto_suspend_challenge.sh</code> — asserts
the running host's state matches layer-1 masking.</li>
<li><code>challenges/scripts/no_suspend_calls_challenge.sh</code> — wraps the
scanner as a challenge that runs in CI / <code>run_all_challenges.sh</code>.</li>
</ol>
<p dir="auto"><strong>Enforcement:</strong> Every project's CI / <code>run_all_challenges.sh</code>
equivalent MUST run both challenges (host state + source tree). A
violation in either channel blocks merge. Adding files to the
scanner's <code>EXCLUDE_PATHS</code> requires an explicit justification comment
identifying the non-host context.</p>
<p dir="auto"><strong>See also:</strong> <code>docs/HOST_POWER_MANAGEMENT.md</code> for full background and
runbook.</p>

<div class="markdown-heading" dir="auto"><h2 tabindex="-1" class="heading-element" dir="auto">Definition of Done</h2><a id="user-content-definition-of-done" class="anchor" aria-label="Permalink: Definition of Done" href="#definition-of-done"><svg class="octicon octicon-link" viewBox="0 0 16 16" version="1.1" width="16" height="16" aria-hidden="true"><path d="m7.775 3.275 1.25-1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1 4.95 4.95l-2.5 2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1-4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1 .018-1.042.751.751 0 0 1 1.042-.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l2.5-2.5a2.002 2.002 0 0 0-2.83-2.83l-1.25 1.25a.751.751 0 0 1-1.042-.018.751.751 0 0 1-.018-1.042Zm-4.69 9.64a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l1.25-1.25a.751.751 0 0 1 1.042.018.751.751 0 0 1 .018 1.042l-1.25 1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1-4.95-4.95l2.5-2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1 4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1-.018 1.042.751.751 0 0 1-1.042.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0-2.83 0l-2.5 2.5a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 0 2.83Z"></path></svg></a></div>
<p dir="auto">A change is done when:</p>
<ol dir="auto">
<li>The code change is committed.</li>
<li>All project-level tests pass on a clean clone.</li>
<li>All challenges in <code>challenges/scripts/</code> pass on the running host.</li>
<li>Governance docs (<code>CONSTITUTION.md</code>, <code>AGENTS.md</code>, <code>CLAUDE.md</code>) are
coherent with the change.</li>
</ol>
